title: [FIXED] B1 — every guarded Error branch now mark_failed + Sentry-captures (no infinite re-send)
detail: AC7 'DB failure -> failed + Sentry' + AD-15 'fail loudly' now met on all 5 Error branches. A poison row terminalises + captures instead of looping. Happy-path guard (WHERE attempt_count=$n) + 0-row StoodDown intact.
recommended_fix: None — correctly fixed. Verified the guarded UPDATE WHERE clauses and send-then-claim ordering are unchanged, so exactly-once holds.

title: [FIXED] W1 — production attempt-log `at` now stamped with a real RFC3339 now
detail: Both production entry points now pass a real ISO string via now_iso() (house pattern: payment_handler/dsar/posthog). The cadence SELECT's COALESCE(NULLIF($1,'')::timestamptz, now()) accepts it unchanged.
recommended_fix: None — correctly fixed. now_iso() is computed once per tick; `at`-stamp and cadence `now` are now consistent.

title: [FIXED] W2 — warm-handoff render merges this tick's REAL reminder-2 outcomes (no fabricated entry)
evidence:
dispatch_warm_handoff(db, deps, now_iso, row, context, outcomes)
...
    parse_attempts_entries(row.attempts)
    |> list.append(outcomes_to_entries(outcomes, now_iso))
...
fn outcomes_to_entries(outcomes, at) {
  list.map(outcomes, fn(o) { AttemptEntry(at:, channel: messages.channel_name(o.channel), outcome: messages.outcome_name(o.outcome), detail: o.detail) })
}
detail: The render now appends the real send_reminder(ReminderTwo) outcomes (email+SMS), mirroring exactly what sweep_advance committed to the row. No double-count: prior (stale row) + this-tick == stored attempts.

title: [FIXED] W5 — fake-clock test pins AD-4 offsets 24/24/48/48h per step
evidence:
offset_seconds(db, t0, anchor) |> should.equal(24 * 3600)
  offset_seconds(db, t24, anchor) |> should.equal(24 * 3600)
  offset_seconds(db, t48, anchor) |> should.equal(48 * 3600)
  offset_seconds(db, t96, anchor) |> should.equal(48 * 3600)
detail: Seeds one row per cadence position at a shared anchor, runs the sweep +1s later, asserts next_attempt_at-anchor in seconds. sweep_advance/sweep_claim_t0 add the increment to CURRENT next_attempt_at, so the offsets are exact (not now()-relative).
recommended_fix: None — correctly fixed; the test is a true pin (a wrong constant fails it).
